text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble Gum Fellow's summer training camp
is finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "How much we can build up this summer will dictate the results in the autumn, after all."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Train me hard, Trainer.
I'll follow you anywhere!
choice_data_list: Let's get fired up and do this!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Oh.
You're rooming with Air Groove this year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Well, if it's you,
I'm sure your daily life won't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha, look who's got their trust now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad to be paired with you, Air Groove.
With you, I feel we won't miss a single detail."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You know how Air Groove is great at cleaning, right?
I can't stand dusty rooms, so I really appreciate having someone who's good at tidying up around.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hoh. In that case, while we're at it, I'll thoroughly inspect how well you usually do your cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whoops.
I'd better work crazy hard to meet the "Empress's" high standards!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Let us both make this a summer of great leaps forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the summer training camp that held our breakthrough began—
